description: List of local traffic sign authorities is a data set listed in data.gov.il, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry of Transport and Road Safety. Coverage: Israel. Its title on the portal is "רשימת רשויות תמרור מקומיות" (Hebrew). The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Transport and Road Safety. Its tags are בטיחות בדרכים, זכות דרך, חצב, משרד התחבורה, רשות תמרור מקומית. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2023-03-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-il-portal.
